risks.title: Management Changes
risks.score_rationale: Leadership transition with appointment of Michael A. Wichterich as Interim President and CEO on February 6, 2026, replacing Domenic J. Dell Osso, Jr. may impact strategy and operations. (Position dans le 10-K: Item 1A)
risks.summary: Le changement de direction peut entraîner des changements dans la stratégie et la direction de l'entreprise, ce qui peut avoir un impact sur les résultats financiers.

risks.title: Commodity Price Volatility
risks.score_rationale: Company heavily dependent on natural gas and oil prices, with 2031 million of incremental revenue in 2025 driven by higher gas prices. Significant exposure to price fluctuations. (Position dans le 10-K: Item 1A)
risks.summary: L'entreprise est fortement exposée aux fluctuations des prix des matières premières, ce qui peut avoir un impact matériel sur les résultats financiers.

risks.title: Debt Obligations
risks.score_rationale: Company assumed Southwestern's Senior Notes in merger, increasing interest expense to 235 million in 2025. Significant debt obligations may impact financial flexibility. (Position dans le 10-K: Item 1A)
risks.summary: L'entreprise a des obligations de dette importantes héritées de la fusion Southwestern, ce qui peut avoir un impact sur les résultats financiers en cas de difficultés de refinancement.

risks.title: Liquidity and Capital Management
risks.score_rationale: As of December 31, 2025, company maintains 4.1 billion in liquidity including 616 million cash and 3.5 billion unused borrowing capacity. Adequate but requires ongoing management. (Position dans le 10-K: Item 1A)
risks.summary: L'entreprise dispose de liquidités adéquates (4,1 milliards) mais doit gérer activement ses besoins de financement suite à la fusion Southwestern.

risks.title: Environmental and Regulatory Compliance
risks.score_rationale: Natural gas and oil operations subject to strict environmental regulations. Company has environmental risk assessment processes and provisions for contingencies. No material environmental proceedings disclosed as of December 31, 2025. (Position dans le 10-K: Item 1A)
risks.summary: L'entreprise est soumise à des réglementations environnementales strictes, ce qui peut avoir un impact sur les résultats financiers en cas de non-conformité ou de contamination.

risks.title: Integration and Operational Risk
risks.score_rationale: Southwestern merger substantially increased operations with doubled production and added oil/NGL capabilities. Integration success critical for realizing merger synergies. (Position dans le 10-K: Item 1A)
risks.summary: L'intégration réussie de la fusion Southwestern est critique pour réaliser les synergies escomptées et maintenir la compétitivité du marché.

company_description: Expand Energy Corporation operates as an independent natural gas production company in the United States. The company engages in acquisition, exploration, and development of properties to produce oil, natural gas, and natural gas liquids. It holds interests in the Marcellus Shale in the northern Appalachian Basin in Pennsylvania; the Marcellus and Utica Shales in Ohio and West Virginia; and the Haynesville and Bossier Shales in Louisiana and Texas. Expand Energy Corporation was formerly known as Chesapeake Energy Corporation and changed its name to Expand Energy Corporation in October 2024. The company was founded in 1989 and is based in Oklahoma City, Oklahoma.
